title: CLOSE CALL FOR PLAYER 2 TOO
why: A round that reaches you inside your roll pays CLOSE CALL: 25 to the run score and the roll stamina back. Only the host's own player could get it: a round that reaches player 2 is worked out in the host window and sent to his window as a hit, and his window never checked it for a CLOSE CALL. Proven in the cloud: the host rolling through a round got 25 and his stamina back; the same round reaching player 2 in his roll gave nothing. The host now tells player 2's window when the hit is a round, and his window pays the CLOSE CALL exactly as the host's does. A blade, a blast or a bite pays nothing, as for the host. Ship it with or after the close call fix for a downed player.
now: Player 2 gets CLOSE CALL when a round reaches him inside his roll, as the host does.

  var q, m;

m={t:'hit',seat:p.seat,dmg:+(+amt).toFixed(2),kind:netClean(src,16),name:netClean(srcName,24)}; if(LATCH_BITE) m.pi=1;   // crawlerlatch
  if(rd) m.rd=1;   // v16.xx (cloud-feel-closecall-p2), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a round, so his window can call CLOSE CALL on it as the host's own round does

if(dist(b,bd)<bd.r+3){ netHitPlayer(bd,b.dmg,(b.owner&&b.owner.kind)||'other',(b.owner&&b.owner.name)||'',b.x-b.vx*0.05,b.y-b.vy*0.05,true); return true; }   // v16.xx (cloud-feel-closecall-p2): marked as a round

edits.anchor: LATCH_BITE=m.pi?1:0;   // crawlerlatch: a crawler hanging on him bites through his roll too
